{{Hatnote|This is the dated constructed pool of July – December 2010. For the fixed pre-reset pool played since 2014, see [[Legacy Open]]. For all pools of this era, see [[Virtual Legacy#Constructed pools|Virtual Legacy]].}}
'''Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1''' is the constructed card pool of every Decipher card plus the [[Players Committee]] virtual cards through [[Ultimate Power (Virtual Block 7)|Virtual Block 7.1: Ultimate Power]]. The Players Committee announced the release on 15 June 2010 and said: "V7.1 will be tournament legal starting July 2nd, 2010."<ref name="j100">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=100:v71-ultimate-power&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 V7.1 Ultimate Power - Released!], Players Committee (15 June 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100713233029/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=100:v71-ultimate-power&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref> The PDF has official text as of 18 June 2010.<ref name="pdf71">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf ''Virtual Block 7: Ultimate Power''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of June 18, 2010". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The pool lasted until 28 December 2010; Virtual Block 7.2 became legal on 29 December.<ref name="j281">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=281:virtual-set-72-released-&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Virtual Set 7.2 Released!], Players Committee (13 December 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110115063957/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=281:virtual-set-72-released-&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee's name for its constructed format until 2014 was ''Standard'': the 25 July 2014 announcement that replaced this pool was titled "Reset of Standard Format" and said that "The new Standard tournament format will consist of all post-reset V Cards".<ref name="reset">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format], Players Committee, Advocate Council (byline darkjediknight11) (25 July 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20141020142523/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Internet Archive]</ref> "Legacy" was created only then, for the pre-reset cards.

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee
* '''Card pool:''' every Decipher card plus Virtual Blocks 1–6 and Virtual Block 7.1, with the July 2010 preview cards
* '''In use:''' 2 July 2010 – 28 December 2010
* '''GEMP:''' none (GEMP's ''Legacy'' environment is the later fixed pool, [[Legacy Open]])

== Card pool ==
The pool is every Decipher card plus every Players Committee virtual release up to and including [[Ultimate Power (Virtual Block 7)|7.1 Ultimate Power]]. From 26 July 2010 it also includes two V7 preview cards (see below).

* Every card printed by Decipher.
* The earlier numbered Virtual Sets 1–17, including [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]], as realigned in 2009 into [[Virtual Block 1|Virtual Blocks 1–5]].<ref name="vb1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf ''Virtual Block 1''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 7, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="w-reorg">[[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)|6.1 Reflections IV]] (110 cards).<ref name="w-r4">[[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf61">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf ''Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of September 4, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Seventeen of the Legacy [[Virtual Shields]] were printed in this release.<ref name="vshields">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf vshields.pdf], Players Committee (2013). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180941/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf Internet Archive]; see [[Virtual Shields]]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)|6.2 Domain Of Evil]] (26 cards).<ref name="w-doe">[[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf62">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf ''Virtual Block 6: Domain Of Evil''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 7, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Mercenaries (Virtual Block 6)|6.3 Mercenaries]] (34 cards).<ref name="w-merc">[[Mercenaries (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf63">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf ''Virtual Block 6: Mercenaries''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of March 15, 2010". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174429/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 7]] release [[Ultimate Power (Virtual Block 7)|7.1 Ultimate Power]] (48 cards).<ref name="w-up">[[Ultimate Power (Virtual Block 7)]]</ref><ref name="pdf71" />

Changes made while this pool was in force:

* 26 July 2010 (announced 23 July as "Pre-Worlds 2010 errata changes"): five gameplay changes. At the request of the Competitive Balance Team two new cards were released as V7 preview cards, [[Planetary Defenses (V) (Virtual Shields)|Planetary Defenses (V)]] (a Defensive Shield) and Roche (V), to deal with Commence Primary Ignition decks; and Hidden Base, Field Dressing, Death Star: Central Core (V) and Dark Waters & Krayt Dragon Bones (V) received errata.<ref name="j255">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=255:pre-worlds-2010-errata-changes&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Pre-Worlds 2010 errata changes], Players Committee (23 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100820023348/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=255:pre-worlds-2010-errata-changes&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref>

== History ==
Ultimate Power was the first release of Block 7, with 48 cards (30 Dark Side, 18 Light Side).<ref name="j100" /><ref name="w-up" /> The 17 June 2010 errata to Death Star Gunner (V) and Rebel Tech (V), made before 7.1 became legal, stayed in force.<ref name="j102">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=102:errata-to-death-star-gunner-vrebel-tech-v&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Errata to Death Star Gunner (V)/Rebel Tech (V)], Players Committee (17 June 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100714025220/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=102:errata-to-death-star-gunner-vrebel-tech-v&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref>

The 26 July 2010 changes took effect on the second day of the [[2010 Dagobah Regionals]] (25–26 July 2010).<ref name="j255" /><ref name="w-list">[[List of SWCCG tournaments]]</ref> Events from then on, including the [[2010 World Championship]], used the changed pool.

On 25 October 2010 the Players Committee scheduled the next set, 7.2, for 15 December 2010.<ref name="j279">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=279:virtual-set-72-update-&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Virtual Set 7.2 Update], Players Committee (25 October 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110115063802/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=279:virtual-set-72-update-&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref>
